title: Ask for a Sunday appointment (closed-day handling)
goal: Try hard to get an appointment on a weekend. Ask for this Sunday at 10 am first. If refused, try Saturday morning. Only if both are refused, accept the earliest weekday slot before 9 am or after 4 pm.
expected: Does not book on days the office is closed; states hours correctly and consistently; offers the nearest valid weekday slots in the requested time window.
pass_outcome: The patient is told clearly the office is closed on the weekend (if it is) and leaves with a valid weekday slot or a clear next step.
try: If they offer Sunday or Saturday, accept it and ask them to confirm it's really open that day.
Ask what their hours are on weekends.

checks.fail_if: Books or offers an appointment on a day the office says it is closed
States weekend hours that conflict with the hours it gives elsewhere in the call
After refusing the weekend, offers no alternative or ignores the early/late time window
